content:
{'text': '天文台預計，今天的室外最高氣溫為 34 度，接近 2022 年的「最熱大暑」 34.9 度，相比去年「大暑」高約 4 度。', 'translation': 'The Observatory forecasts that today\'s outdoor maximum temperature will be 34 degrees, close to the 34.9 degrees recorded on the "hottest Great Heat" in 2022, and about 4 degrees higher than last year\'s "Great Heat".'}

{'text': '天文台持續發出酷熱天氣警告，預測今日大致天晴，但上午至中午會有部分地區有驟雨，日間氣溫酷熱。另外，因副熱帶高壓脊為香港帶來晴朗，但沿岸亦會受驟雨影響。', 'translation': 'The Observatory has maintained the Very Hot Weather Warning, forecasting that today will be mostly fine, but with showers in some areas from morning to noon, and very hot temperatures during the day. In addition, a subtropical ridge is bringing fine weather to Hong Kong, but the coastal areas will also be affected by showers.'}

{'text': '「大暑」引起的熱浪，令香港街頭猶如焗爐般悶熱，旺角麥花臣球場溫度計更錄得 40.8 度高溫。', 'translation': 'The heat wave brought on by the "Great Heat" has made the streets of Hong Kong as stifling as an oven, with the thermometer at Macpherson Playground in Mong Kok recording a high temperature of 40.8 degrees.'}

{'text': '過去的大暑，最高氣溫為 2022 年的 34.9 度，最低為 1965 年的 22.2 度。', 'translation': 'In past Great Heat days, the highest temperature recorded was 34.9 degrees in 2022, and the lowest was 22.2 degrees in 1965.'}

{'text': '另外，往年大暑錄得最高平均相對濕度，以及最高總雨量為 1994 年 96%和 195.1 毫米，最低平均相對濕度為 1968 年的 70%。', 'translation': 'In addition, among past Great Heat days, the highest average relative humidity and the highest total rainfall recorded were 96% and 195.1 millimetres in 1994, while the lowest average relative humidity was 70% in 1968.'}
